triggers.name: on_auth_user_created
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()

triggers.name: trigger_notify_drivers_new_job
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trigger_notify_drivers_new_job AFTER INSERT ON public.jobs FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_drivers_new_job()

functions.name: handle_new_user
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
begin
  insert into public.profiles (id, full_name, phone, role)
    values (
        new.id,
            new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'full_name',
                new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'phone',
                    coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data ->> 'role', 'client')
                      );

                        return new;
                        end;
                        $function$

functions.name: is_admin
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_admin()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
          FROM public.profiles
              WHERE id = auth.uid()
                    AND role = 'admin'
                      );
                      $function$

functions.name: notify_drivers_new_job
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.notify_drivers_new_job()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.status = 'requested'
       AND NEW.driver_id IS NULL THEN

           INSERT INTO public.notifications (
                 user_id,
                       title,
                             message,
                                   type,
                                         job_id
                                             )
                                                 SELECT
                                                       id,
                                                             '🚚 Nueva solicitud de flete',
                                                                   'Hay un nuevo servicio disponible para aceptar.',
                                                                         'info',
                                                                               NEW.id
                                                                                   FROM public.profiles
                                                                                       WHERE role = 'driver';

                                                                                         END IF;

                                                                                           RETURN NEW;
                                                                                           END;
                                                                                           $function$
